يستبدلوا (form X)
# يَسْتَبْدِلُوا (yastabdilū) /jas.tab.di.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَبْدَلَ (istabdala)
# يُسْتَبْدَلُوا (yustabdalū) /jus.tab.da.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَبْدَلَ (istabdala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
